title: M13, CH36: the Now list overflows at 4 rows. The 4th row is cut and Record/Today/localhost scroll out of view while ~250 px of empty chat area sits below. Rows are capped at 8.
repro: With 4 listed sessions (vibepet, ember, atlas, delta), click Net.
Look at the Now list without scrolling.
Scroll the list to find the footer.
expected: With 5–15 sessions, every live session (up to 15) and the localhost/recording footer are visible without scrolling, or the panel grows into its free height.
actual: 3 of 4 rows are fully visible; delta's row is cut in half. Record a short, Today and both localhost servers are below the fold (#now max-height 46% of the panel), while the chat area under it is empty. The list renders at most 8 rows (renderHome slice(0, 8)), so at 9+ sessions the rest are never shown.
truth: 01:58:43Z: vibepet done, ember loop, atlas working, delta fan-out listed. kestrel and beacon blocked but not listed.

title: Keyboard focus on a row button is wiped by the 3 s re-render, and rows are not focusable, so rows cannot be used from the keyboard
repro: Open Home.
Shift+Tab from the composer to a row's ◎ button.
Wait 3 s.
expected: Focus stays put, and every row is reachable and actionable by keyboard (Tab, arrows or number keys).
actual: Focus fell back to the page body 2.5 s later, when the tick rebuilt #now. Row bodies have no focus stop.
truth: delta done, idle at its prompt.

title: Tab off the end of the panel, or Shift+Tab off its start, closes Home
repro: Open Home (focus is in the composer).
Press Tab once, or Shift+Tab until past the ⋯ button.
actual: Focus leaves the page (activeElement = body), the window blurs and Home closes. Seen with trusted key events in the test instance.

why: Overflows at 3 rows already: after one note in the chat, reopened Home sizes #now to 46% = 211 px (panel 460 px); kestrel 89 + ember 53 + atlas 71 px need 263 px, so atlas's row shows 57 of 71 px and Record/Today are wholly below the fold while #msgs under it holds one note (152 px). With an empty chat (62% = 264 px) exactly 3 rows + footer fit, so a 4th overflows; at 4 rows (03:00:55-03:01:17Z) the list scrolled and the footer was cut. The 8-row cap is code (slice(0, 8)); not observable with 6 members.

Shift+Tab x3 from the composer put focus on atlas's ◎ button; 253 ms later (the next tick) focus was BODY. renderHome rebuilds #now through innerHTML on every 3 s tick and only spares a focused INPUT; .nr rows have tabIndex -1 (no focus stop) and there are no number keys, so rows cannot be operated from the keyboard.
cause: renderer/app.js:920 (innerHTML rebuild on each tick via renderer/app.js:436); renderer/app.js:900 (guard only for INPUT)

why: Tab from the composer: activeElement -> BODY, document.hasFocus() -> false, one window blur, Home closed; Shift+Tab from ⋯: same (02:58:15Z, trusted CDP key events). Caveat: like the driver's, this test instance never holds the OS focus. The blur handler closes Home on any blur, so focus leaving the document dismisses the panel instead of wrapping.
cause: renderer/app.js:803 (window blur -> closeChat; no focus wrap inside #chat)

title: CH34: the keyboard path from the bar to a row action takes 17 Shift+Tabs; rows never take focus (no keyboard jump) and the walk stops on "● Record a short"
repro: Home with 3 rows and 2 localhost servers; caret in the bar
Press Shift+Tab until kestrel's Reply button has focus
expected: ≤ 2 keys to act on the top row (e.g. ⌘1 or ↑ into the list, ⏎ = primary action).
actual: 17 presses: messages, each server's ✕ and Open, Today, "● Record a short" (where ⏎ would start a screen recording), then each row's ◎ ✓ ▶ bottom-up, then Reply. The rows themselves (click = jump) are not focusable.
truth: kestrel idle 99 s, turn ended with a question ("Should the deploy script have unit tests?"), shown as needs + Reply

why: Rows are divs with tabIndex -1, so they never take focus. From the bar, Shift+Tab walks the 5 quick-ask chips, Today and "● Record a short" (Enter there would start a capture), then each row's buttons bottom-up. kestrel showed needs + Reply (its turn ended with a question 63 s earlier): Reply came at press 11, with 1 row and no servers. With 3 rows, the top row's first button came at press 14. The driver's 17 presses (3 rows + 2 servers) fits the same walk.
cause: renderer/app.js:910 (row is a non-focusable div; click-only jump at app.js:927); renderer/index.html:14-31 (footer and chips sit between the bar and the rows in tab order)

title: Reply box steals focus on every 3 s redraw: words typed in the chat bar land in a session's reply box
repro: A session ends its turn with a question (row 'needs' with Reply)
Click Reply (reply box opens)
Click into the chat input and type 'what is atlas doing' at a normal pace (~7 s)
expected: The text stays in the chat input; an open reply box never takes focus on its own.
actual: Chat input ended with 'what '; 'is atlas doing' landed in kestrel's reply box after the next redraw moved focus there mid-word. Pressing Enter would send those words to kestrel as its answer (on a GUI terminal: typed into the session).
truth: kestrel idle after asking 'Should the deploy script have unit tests?'

title: The 3 s redraw wipes row interaction state: a click spanning it is dropped, keyboard focus on a row button falls to <body>, text selection is cleared
repro: Home with a row visible
(a) Press ◎ and release 3.3 s later (spans a redraw); repeat with a 120 ms click
(b) Shift+Tab from the chat input to a row button, wait 3 s, press Enter
(c) Drag-select the row's goal text, wait 3.4 s
expected: A redraw that changes nothing keeps pending clicks, focus and selection.
actual: (a) 0 of 2 held clicks took effect; 2 of 2 normal clicks did. (b) Focus moved to <body> at the first redraw (2977 ms after focusing); Enter then did nothing. (c) Selection gone within 3.4 s. Any hand click that happens to straddle a tick (~3% of 100 ms clicks) is silently lost.

title: Selecting text in a row fires a jump (and a failed jump overwrites the clipboard with a resume command)
repro: Home with a row visible
Drag across the row's goal/ask text to select it
actual: The drag counted as a row click: 1 jump call. On tmux that jump fails and writes `cd … && claude --resume <id>` to the clipboard, replacing what the user meant to copy; the selection itself is wiped by the next redraw.

title: Rows reorder under the pointer and Approve/Reply carry no confirmation naming the session
repro: Home open with 4–5 sessions changing state
Sample the row order every 2 s
expected: Rows the user is aiming at hold still (e.g. while hovered), or acting confirms which session.
actual: 6 order changes in 6.3 min with 4–5 rows; atlas kept jumping ahead of the other running rows because its clock restarted every tick ('atlas · 0s' through its build). A click aimed at one row's button can land on another session's.

why: With kestrel's reply box open, I clicked into the chat bar and typed 'what is atlas doing' at 370 ms/char. The chat bar ended with 'w' and the reply box with 'hat is atlas doing': focus moved into the reply box at the first redraw (284 ms in). Each tick re-renders Home, the 'don't wipe a reply mid-typing' guard covers only inputs inside #now, and the render focuses the reply input.

(a) 3.3 s presses on ◎ spanning a redraw: 0/2 took effect; 120 ms presses between redraws: 2/2 took effect. (b) 8 Shift+Tabs put focus on the row's ◎; at the first redraw (2973 ms) document.activeElement became BODY. (c) A selection in the ask line was cleared at the first redraw (2054 ms). Home's #now innerHTML is rebuilt on every 3 s tick even when nothing changed.

A drag across kestrel's ask line selected 'hould dry-run output be stored in lo' and fired 1 ipc:jump → {ok:false}, plus 1 clipboard write of 'cd … && claude --resume <sid>' that would replace what the user meant to copy. The row click handler jumps on any click that isn't on a button or form; it never checks for a selection or a drag.

Over 16 min (3814 samples at 250 ms), existing rows moved under a static pointer 40 times, by up to 136 px. Examples: kestrel 217→144 when atlas's row appeared (02:48:32); ember/atlas 196→269 and 251→324 when delta's ready row was inserted above them (02:58:09). kestrel and atlas swapped places between 02:42:36 and 02:43:05 when atlas's clock restarted. 'atlas · 0s' shows on every tick: unstick() flips stalled→working, so since resets each scan, and rows of the same rank sort newest-since first. There is no hover freeze, and Approve fires at once with no confirmation. Correction: Reply's box does name the session ('Reply to Deploy.sh dry run…').
